# Welcome

This is the documentation for the CSS implementation of the Airbus Design System : [goto/design-system](http://goto.airbus.corp/design-system)

Other **official implementations**

* React (*preferred standard*): https://react.design-system.airbus.corp
* Angular (*restricted standard*): https://angular.design-system.airbus.corp

Find official and community resources in our [Awesome Design System](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/awesome-design-system) curated list.

## 👋 Newcomers

Please **submit a request to get onboarded** : [goto/design-system-onboarding](http://goto.airbus.corp/design-system-onboarding)

We will give you access to everything you need to get started.

For any question, feedback or issue [join our chatroom](https://mail.google.com/chat/u/0/#browse/chat/q=%22Airbus+Design+System%22\&sorganization=outside\&smembership=all)

## Installation

Install the latest version and save it in your `package.json` dependencies. (For npm configuration see [our github readme](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system#environment-setup))

```
npm install @airbus/styles
```

To install a specific version or an alpha/beta/rc release

```bash
npm install @airbus/styles@3.3.1 --save-exact # specific stable release
npm install @airbus/styles@next --save-exact # latest alpha/beta/rc release
npm install @airbus/styles@3.0.0-beta.1 --save-exact # specific alpha/beta/rc release
```

The compiled stylesheets are available in the dist folder for currently supported brands

* dist/css/airbus/stylesheet.css
* dist/css/skywise/stylesheet.css

## Usage

Like other CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap or Bulma, using Airbus Design System components is as simple as applying the right CSS classes to HTML elements.

Please refer to each component's documentation page to see how they can be used.

Our stylesheets include some basic global styles, see <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Baseline" story="docs">Baseline</LinkTo>

### Standard Font

Airbus Design System has been designed with the Inter font in mind, but this font is **not** included in the library.

To install the Inter font and save it in your `package.json` dependencies, run:

```shell
npm install @fontsource/inter
```

Then, you can import it within your app entry point. (if you cannot import from node_modules, copy files to your static folder)

```js
import "@fontsource/inter/300.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/400.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/500.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/700.css";
```

Alternatively, you can load the Inter font from google CDN:

```html
<link
  rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Inter:300,400,500,700&display=swap"
/>
```

### Monospace Font

If you need to use a monospace font, for example to convey system messages, setup Roboto Mono font.

```shell
npm install @fontsource/roboto-mono
```

```js
import "@fontsource/roboto-mono";
```

Alternatively, from google CDN

```html
<link
  rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Mono&display=swap"
/>
```

### Icons

We recommend using Airbus or Material Icons.
See <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Icons" story="docs">Visual Styles/Icons</LinkTo>

## Google Apps Script

You can use this Apps Script library to integrate the styles and icons from Airbus Design System : https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system-apps-script<br />

CSS variables are also available with the <a href="https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/tree/develop/packages/design-tokens" target="blank" dsLink>design tokens</a> (colors, fontsizes, spacing, etc.)
